import hashlib,subprocess,sys
R=sys.argv[1]
for p in ['tools/mutate-and-run.sh','tools/bash-witness-study.py']:
    out=subprocess.run(['git','-C',R,'log','--format=%H','--reverse','--',p],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split()
    for c in out:
        data=subprocess.run(['git','-C',R,'show',c+':'+p],capture_output=True).stdout
        print(p, c, hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
